title: Royal Alberta Museum

services.name: Daily Admission
services.desc: Découvrez la richesse et la vitalité de l’esprit franco-albertain. Chez nous : la francophonie de l’Alberta vous invite à faire connaissance avec des francophones, à écouter leurs récits et à saluer leurs réalisations à l’échelle de la province. Plongez dans l’univers des communautés franco-albertaines, depuis les propriétés familiales ancestrales jusqu’aux lieux communautaires d’aujourd’hui. Faites la rencontre d’artistes, d’écrivains, de journalistes, d’éducateurs et de chefs de file qui ont laissé leur empreinte dans le paysage socioculturel de notre province. Chez nous vous invite à observer de près, à écouter attentivement et à saisir la force inébranlable des communautés

services.name: Drop-in Sketching
services.desc: Have you ever wished you could use the museum’s collections for sketching inspiration? Now’s your chance! We'll be showcasing rarely seen museum objects to create a still-life setup for you to practice your drawing skills. This month, let’s focus our attention on the little guys - bugs! We will have many-legged critters from Alberta and all over the world for you to sketch. You can even use one of our microscopes to really appreciate all the little details of their anatomy. Tip: If you plan to attend more than one drop-in sketching session, buy a Mammoth Pass to save big ! services.name: School Field Trips
services.desc: Join us for a FREE Mid-Autumn Walking Tour of Edmonton’s Chinatown led by Lan Chan-Marples. This tour will light up the night with paper lanterns and cover the fascinating history of Chinatown while incorporating elements of a Mid-Autumn Festival. The tour begins in the RAM lobby and will travel to both historical Chinatown and Commercial Chinatown before returning to the museum. Lan Chan-Marple is a local historian and community advocate who specializes in Edmonton’s Chinese history. She is passionate about preserving cultural heritage and sharing stories that connect generations. This is an outdoor walking tour where we will travel by sidewalks and crosswalks. services.name: Full Building Rental
services.desc: Create a truly unique after-hours experience with exclusive access to the Royal Alberta Museum. Full building rentals offer guests the opportunity to explore galleries and exhibits in a private setting while enjoying an event unlike any other venue in Edmonton. The starting rate for renting exclusive access to the museum, including access to all the galleries, is $5000 per hour. We acknowledge that the museum sits on Treaty 6 territory, a traditional meeting grounds, gathering place, and travelling route of the Cree, Saulteaux, Blackfoot, Métis, Dene and Nakota Sioux.
